expectations.text: Flags application/use-cases/assign-tag.ts for depending on the whole Container instead of a narrow port
expectations.evidence: Finding #1: 'The use-case imports Container... and reaches into it as container.tags.repository, so the application layer depends directly on infrastructure wiring instead of declaring its own port dependency'

expectations.text: Flags adapters/outbound/persistence/tag-repository.ts for returning an HTTP DTO shape and/or throwing a transport-specific error (statusCode)
expectations.evidence: Finding #4: 'defines a TagResponseDto (snake_case pull_id field) inside the persistence adapter and returns it from assign()... an outbound persistence adapter should not be shaping an HTTP-facing response DTO'

expectations.text: Flags index.ts for using a barrel export (export *) that hides the dependency direction
expectations.evidence: Finding #6: 'The barrel file re-exports symbols from every layer... via export *, collapsing the onion's layer boundaries into one flat public surface'
